source.description: One genuine dashboard capture. Detail PNGs are crops; GIF motion zooms the camera, not application state.

frames.caption: HospitalSim brings hospital operations into one dashboard.
Choose a demand scenario, adjust speed, run the simulation, or advance one hour.
Read active patients, bed occupancy, staff on duty, and patients waiting for care.
Department capacity shows occupied beds against the available beds in each care unit.
Open the project documentation and Swagger API from the top navigation.
The browser simulation uses synthetic data and saves its progress on this device.
